title: The Ice Famine
logline: A catastrophic drought hits an outpost, and refugees hire a pilot to cripple a massive water tanker so they can siphon its cargo.

roles.description: Desperate, parched, willing to do anything to save their family.
Slick, well-hydrated, sees the drought as a business opportunity.
A massive, heavily guarded orbital reservoir.
A colossal freighter filled with millions of gallons of fresh water.
An automated defense turret guarding the water.
A ruthless monopoly controlling the system's water supply.

public_situation: A massive solar flare from the dying star has evaporated the local moisture farms, causing severe water rationing.
private_truth: The cartel broker knew the flare was coming and secretly diverted the system's water supply into a hidden tanker to sell back at extortionate prices.

beats.public_change: The local water prices quadruple overnight.

missions.reason: The refugee begs the pilot to mine and deliver ice directly to the storage facility.
missions.private_fact: The cartel guards immediately confiscate the ice and refuse to distribute it.

beats.public_change: Riots break out at the water distribution center.

missions.reason: The refugee asks the pilot to meet a sympathetic guard outside the facility to collect the shield codes for the hidden tanker.
missions.private_fact: The broker left the access codes lightly guarded because they never expected a starving populace to fight back.

beats.public_change: The refugee group launches a desperate fleet of skiffs to drain the water tanker.

missions.reason: The pilot must attack the tanker's defenses to let the refugee skiffs dock and siphon the water.
missions.private_fact: The broker hails the pilot from inside the tanker, offering them a fortune to abandon the refugees and escort the tanker to safety.

resolutions.summary: The refugees dock with the tanker and distribute the water. The broker is ruined, and the cartel loses its grip on the system.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot busted open a cartel water ship and let a dying colony drink it dry.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the broker's offer.
resolutions.summary: The tanker escapes. The colony is devastated by the drought, but the pilot and broker make a fortune.
The cartel easily fends off the refugees and jumps the tanker away. The colony slowly dies of thirst.

loose_threads.detail: The broker received highly classified astronomical data predicting the solar flare months in advance.
The automated drones were using military-grade targeting software restricted to the naval reserves.

radio_hooks: Water rationing protests turn violent at {role:ice_storage}.

voice_direction.water_broker: Smooth, condescending, speaks like someone who has never been thirsty.
